baseline.change: Learn arm torques from reset, including while driving. Removes the expert holding controller. Physical input scales; frozen iteration-40 driving.

encoder_noise.change: Add Gaussian encoder-angle noise, standard deviation 0.0001 rad, before quantisation and velocity estimation. Networks unchanged.

basics_standard.change: Standardise arm inputs using training-set means and standard deviations. Keep the driving checkpoint and training budgets unchanged.

damping.change: Retain encoder noise and add the course motor damping term, c=1. Networks unchanged.

elasticity.change: Retain noise and damping; add the course elasticity term, k=1, towards zero joint angle. Networks unchanged.

inertia.change: Retain previous effects; add motor inertia J=0.001 kg m² using the previous acceleration. Networks unchanged.

delay.change: Add a causal 3 ms observation delay to noise, damping, elasticity and inertia. Networks unchanged.

random_start_fixed.change: Retain all five disturbances and randomise starting x/y within ±0.15 m and heading within ±30 degrees. Networks unchanged.

random_start_retrained.change: Retrain driving and reaching on random-start expert data with physical input scales. Evaluate with random starts and all five disturbances. The expert retains its original world-origin parking convention.

random_start_retention.change: Use exactly the random-start-retrained networks, but restore original starts and clean physics. This changes the evaluation condition, not the weights.

imperfect_park.change: Retrain after omitting prepared training rows within ±0.25 s of PARK. This was an unapproved substitution for bursty packet loss. Preserve it as exploratory evidence only; it does not complete the requested packet-loss experiment.

standard_stack.change: Test the clean-trained standardised model under all five disturbances and random starts. This is a separate comparison: the preceding noise ladder used the physical-scale baseline.

dart.change: Add two batches of 100 perturbed expert episodes to the original data; 199 reached successfully and contributed training rows. Fixed action-noise standard deviations: wheels 0.025 rad/s, arm 0.5 N m, held for 33 ms. Labels are clean expert commands at visited states. DART-inspired fixed noise, not the full adaptive DART algorithm.

dart_stack.change: Test the DART-trained model under all five disturbances and random starts. Training used action perturbations, not the full evaluation disturbance stack.

dagger.change: Three rounds of 100 student rollouts with stateful shadow-expert labels, retaining the original data and all earlier rounds. Round 3 was selected on six fixed validation cases before full testing. New DAgger rows train command outputs only; they do not train PARK, auxiliary distance or STOP targets.

dagger_stack.change: Test the selected DAgger model under all five disturbances and random starts. This is the same checkpoint as its clean test.

dart_dagger.change: Retain original and both DART datasets, then aggregate three rounds of 100 student rollouts with shadow-expert command labels. Round 3 was selected on the six validation cases. New DAgger rows do not train PARK or STOP. Round 2 export was repaired and rerun without loosening the numerical tolerance; the selected model is round 3.

dart_dagger_stack.change: Test the selected combined model under all five disturbances and random starts. No bursty-packet loss, occlusion or direct weight perturbation is included.
